concept: S3 encryption: SSE-KMS with customer managed key for auditability
tests: Choosing the S3 server-side encryption type where the company controls key rotation and every decrypt is logged in CloudTrail.
expected: SSE-KMS with a customer managed key: your own key policy, rotation, every Encrypt/Decrypt logged in CloudTrail. Triggers: "rotation and usage auditable", "controlled by the company", "decrypt calls in CloudTrail".
why_not: SSE-S3 — AWS manages the keys, individual decrypts are not audited; keys in application code — insecure; disabling encryption and relying on a bucket policy — not encryption at all.
